# Producer engine

<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:engine-doc -w @clossys/producer` from `src/engine/`. Do not edit by hand; engine/doc.test.ts fails when this file and the code differ. -->

Every record write of a consumer workspace goes through one engine: it appends one event to a hash-chained, append-only log, under one lock per workspace, and keeps a derived index that is never the source of truth. Files only, no database. The record files themselves (slots, candidates, pins, ledgers, queue entries, requests, library versions, run records) stay where and how they are; the events name them by path and sha256.

## Files

Paths are relative to the workspace root (the folder that holds `clossys/`).

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `.clossys/events.jsonl` | the event log: one JSON event per line, append-only, each line chained to the one before |
| `.clossys/engine.lock` | the engine lock: created with O_EXCL, holds `{ pid, host, at, token }` of its writer |
| `.clossys/index.json` | the derived index, rebuilt from the log plus the records |

Records under `clossys/agents/<director|designer|writer|publisher|producer>/` and `clossys/library/` log to the workspace that holds them; `.clossys` is never committed.

## Types

`src/engine/types.ts` holds each type and its runtime validator (`eventIssues`, `stepIssues`, `runIssues`, `attestationIssues`, `gateIssues`, `draftIssues`).

### EngineEvent

| Field | Rule |
|---|---|
| `schema` | "clossys.event/1" |
| `seq` | integer from 0, one more than the previous line |
| `prev` | sha256 of the previous line's bytes; GENESIS (64 zeros) on line 0 |
| `actor` | who wrote: owner[:ref], planner[:ref], agent:<id>, code:<cli> (non-empty, one line) |
| `kind` | <family>.<op>, lowercase (see Event kinds) |
| `subject` | the record the event is about (non-empty, one line) |
| `at` | ISO-8601 UTC timestamp |
| `inputs` | [{ path, sha256 }]: workspace-relative POSIX paths, sorted and unique; sha256 null when the file is absent |
| `id` | sha256 of the line's canonical JSON without id |

| `endedAt` | optional ISO, not before startedAt |

## The chain

Line n carries `seq` n and `prev`, the sha256 of line n-1's bytes (line 0: `GENESIS`, 64 zeros). Its `id` is the sha256 of its canonical JSON without `id`. `verifyChain(root)` reads the whole log and reports:

| Issue | When |
|---|---|
| `malformed` | a line is not JSON or not an event |
| `torn` | the file does not end with a newline (an interrupted append) |
| `edit` | a line no longer hashes to its own id, or the next line's prev is not its hash |
| `gap` | a seq is higher than the line before it plus one (a line was removed) |
| `reorder` | a seq is not higher than the line before it (lines were moved or duplicated) |

Removing lines from the end leaves a valid shorter chain; the index head is what notices it.

## The one writer

`appendEvent(root, draft)` validates the draft, takes the engine lock, chains the event to the last line, appends it as one line (fsync) and updates the index, all under the lock. It writes nothing on an invalid draft (EngineEventError), a torn or invalid last line (EngineLogError) or a busy lock (EngineBusyError). `recordEvent(paths, draft)` is the call a record writer makes after it wrote its files: the root comes from the first path, the inputs are every path with the sha256 of its bytes now.

A record write under a slot-record lock is one transaction of events (`deferEvents(write)`): its events are held and appended in order when the write returns. A write its guard refuses puts its files back and drops the held events that name them, so a refused write logs nothing and the log never names bytes that are gone. A write that throws without undoing keeps its events.

An agent step of a loop is judged by what it changed: the log may change only by a pure append that verifies on the chain and whose new events name only files the step changed or the run's own state file, and the index only to its rebuild (`engineLogIssue` and `engineIndexIssue`, loop/agent-snapshot.ts).

### Lock

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| create | `open(lock, "wx")`: exactly one writer creates it |
| wait for a live holder | 5000 ms, then EngineBusyError (code `ENGINE_BUSY`) naming the holder; nothing is written |
| stale: same host | the owner pid is no longer alive |
| stale: another host | held longer than 15 min |
| stale: no readable owner | older than 60 s |
| takeover | rename the judged lock aside, compare the moved bytes with the judged ones, put a fresh lock back if they differ |
| release | only while the lock still carries the holder's token |
| order | a writer takes its record lock (slot, agent, entry) first and the engine lock last |

## Writers

Each wired writer keeps its on-disk record and adds one event per write.

| Event kind | Writer | Subject |
|---|---|---|
| `<slot\|agent>.<op>` | `packages/producer/src/records/slot-write.ts` | <agent>[/<slot>]: one per ledger event, op from the ledger op |
| `<slot\|agent>.backfill` | `packages/producer/src/records/slot-write.ts` | <agent>[/<slot>]: a ledger rewritten by the ledger migration |
| `pin.probe-repoint / pin.probe-restore` | `packages/producer/src/records/slot-write.ts` | designer/<slot>: the theme probe's pin swap and its restore |
| `migration.record` | `packages/producer/src/records/slot-write.ts` | migration:<id> |
| `<pin kind>.write` | `packages/producer/src/records/pin.ts` | <agent>/<slot>: a pin or pin-map document |
| `request.create / request.write` | `packages/producer/src/records/request.ts` | request:<id> |
| `queue.create / queue.replace` | `packages/producer/src/queue/entry.ts` | <queue>/<entry id>: every queue entry write, the chat answer path included |
| `library.version` | `packages/producer/src/records/library.ts` | library:<slot>/<element>/v<n> |
| `run.state / run.record / pin.revert` | `packages/producer/src/loop/runner.ts` | loop:<loop>/<run id>: run state, the run's ledger record, a reverted pin |

## Derived index

| Field | What |
|---|---|
| `schema` | "clossys.index/1" |
| `events` | how many lines the log holds |
| `head` | sha256 of the log's last line (null when empty): a removed tail line changes it |
| `subjects` | { <subject>: { seq, kind, actor, at } } of the last event about each subject |
| `records` | { <path>: { seq, logged, disk } }: the last event naming each file, the sha256 it logged and the sha256 of the file on disk now |

The index is never the source of truth: `appendEvent` keeps it current, a rebuild writes it from scratch, and `clossys check --engine` fails when the stored index differs from a rebuild or a record's bytes differ from the sha256 its last event logged.

## Verbs

| Verb | What |
|---|---|
| `clossys index --rebuild` | rewrite .clossys/index.json from the log plus the records, under the engine lock; exit 1 when the chain does not verify |
| `clossys index` | compare the stored index with a rebuild (read-only); exit 1 when they differ |
| `clossys check --engine` | verifyChain, index agreement and record drift on a consumer workspace; exit 1 on any issue |
| `clossys check --side-door` | the engine.side-door scan of a checkout (packages/<producer\|designer\|writer\|publisher\|director>/{src,bin,scripts} and scripts/); exit 1 on any finding |

## Check engine.side-door

Rule R-ENGINE-SIDE-DOOR. A static scan of `packages/<producer|designer|writer|publisher|director>/{src,bin,scripts} and scripts/` (tests and fixtures excluded) that fails on every write to `.clossys/**` or to a slot record outside the engine API. No allowlist and no baseline.

| Finding | Means |
|---|---|
| `write` | writes an engine or slot-record path outside the engine API |
| `sink` | hands an engine or slot-record path to a write wrapper outside the engine API |
| `script` | a script calls a record writer directly; run the clossys verb instead |
| `unpaired` | uses a slot-model file primitive in a file that appends no ledger event, so no engine event names the write |

Write calls: `writeFileSync`, `writeFile`, `appendFileSync`, `appendFile`, `unlinkSync`, `unlink`, `mkdirSync`, `mkdir`, `rmSync`, `rm`, `rmdirSync`, `rmdir`, `renameSync`, `rename`, `copyFileSync`, `copyFile`, `cpSync`, `cp`, `createWriteStream`, `symlinkSync`, `symlink`, `linkSync`, `link`, `truncateSync`, `truncate`, `utimesSync`, `utimes`, `chmodSync`, `chmod`, and an open with a write flag.

The engine API (writes here log events):

| File | Functions | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/producer/src/engine/` | all | the event log, its lock and its derived index |
| `packages/producer/src/records/slot-write.ts` | all | the slot-model writer: every write appends a ledger event, which it logs |
| `packages/producer/src/records/pin.ts` | `writePinDoc` | pin and pin-map documents |
| `packages/producer/src/records/request.ts` | `writeRequest`, `createRequest` | work requests (queue-entry/2) |
| `packages/producer/src/records/library.ts` | `writeElementVersion` | element library versions |
| `packages/producer/src/queue/entry.ts` | `createQueueEntry`, `replaceQueueEntry` | queue entries, the answer write path |
| `packages/producer/src/loop/runner.ts` | `writeLedger`, `revertPin`, `saveState`, `logRun` | loop run records, the run state and the run's pin revert |

Record writers a script must not call directly: `appendEvent`, `recordEvent`, `writePinDoc`, `writeRequest`, `writeElementVersion`, `createQueueEntry`, `replaceQueueEntry`, `writeCandidate`, `writeCandidateBytes`, `writePin`, `writeConfirm`, `writeNotNeeded`, `writeTargetDecision`, `writeTargetConfirm`, `writeTargetNotNeeded`, `writeSeatDecision`, `writeVerdict`, `writeReissue`, `writeCritique`, `writeSlotSeed`, `writeSlotOptions`, `writeSyncedSlot`, `replaceModelFile`, `createModelFile`, `removeModelFile`, `moveModelEntry`.

Slot-model file primitives (`replaceModelFile`, `createModelFile`, `removeModelFile`, `moveModelEntry`, `dropEmptyModelDir`) must be paired in the same file with a ledger appender (`appendIaEvent`, `appendSlotDocEvent`, `appendRetireCandidate`, `appendRetireSlot`, `appendCraftEvent`, `appendMigrationEvents`, `writeSeatDecision`).
